newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Prince Bernhard has cataract operation.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Prince Bernhard has cataract operation.

text.p: Prince Bernhard, the 85- year-old father of Queen Beatrix of The Netherlands, underwent an operation on Saturday to remove a cataract from his left eye, the government information office said.
"The Prince is in a good condition and is expected shortly to be able to resume his duties," it said, adding the Queen's father had returned home to Soestdijk Palace.
In April, the German-born prince had a cataract removed from his right eye.
